g = [[0]*14 for _ in range(15)]
g[0][6]=2
# Original 8-wall rows
wallholes={2:[4],4:[2,7,11],7:[2,9],10:[4,7,11]}
for r, holes in wallholes.items():
    for c in range(14):
        if c not in holes: g[r][c]=8
# beam simulation: current positions from the source
active={6}
prev_wall=0
walls=sorted(wallholes)
for wi,r in enumerate(walls):
    holes=wallholes[r]
    # paint vertical tracks from prior wall to this wall at active positions
    for rr in range(prev_wall+1,r):
        for c in active: g[rr][c]=2
    # each blocked active beam joins nearest holes on either side, extending to edge if absent
    spans=[]
    for c in active:
        if c in holes:
            continue
        left=[h for h in holes if h<c]
        right=[h for h in holes if h>c]
        lo=max(left) if left else 0
        hi=min(right) if right else 13
        spans.append((lo,hi))
    # draw spans in row immediately above this wall
    for lo,hi in spans:
        for c in range(lo,hi+1):
            g[r-1][c]=2
    # mark holes reached by intervals, and preserve active beams through matching holes
    newactive=set(h for h in active if h in holes)
    for lo,hi in spans:
        newactive.update(h for h in holes if lo<=h<=hi)
    # Also if no active beam is blocked but there are existing open gaps, only maintain active.
    for h in newactive: g[r][h]=2
    active=newactive
    prev_wall=r
# extend final channels to bottom
for rr in range(prev_wall+1,15):
    for c in active: g[rr][c]=2
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in g))
print('active',active)
